answer: Proof of Agent economies deploy non-refundable cryptographic stake burning to erect economic friction. Every agent identity registration mandates a public burn of collateral verified through an on-chain cipher. Costs scale via a superlinear function, forcing an attacker who attempts to wander across multiple synthetic identities to pay quadratically or exponentially higher fees. Unlike a velvet glove approach, this protocol imposes strict capital destruction that mathematically guarantees exponential attacker cost.
